name: Elidad
title: The tribal prince of Benjamin during the land distribution
summary: Elidad, son of Kislon, was the leader appointed from the tribe of Benjamin to help distribute the land of Canaan among the tribes of Israel. He was appointed by God through Moses as one of the twelve leaders tasked with dividing the inheritance west of the Jordan.

keyEvents.title: God's command regarding land distribution
keyEvents.description: God gave Moses instructions on how the land of Canaan was to be distributed among the Israelite tribes and commanded that specific men be appointed to lead the division.

keyEvents.title: Appointment as tribal prince
keyEvents.description: Elidad, son of Kislon, was appointed as the representative of the tribe of Benjamin to assist in distributing the promised land.

keyEvents.title: The twelve leaders are appointed
keyEvents.description: Together with eleven other tribal princes, Elidad was appointed by the Lord through Moses to divide the inheritance among the tribes of Israel west of the Jordan.

keyEvents.title: Eleazar and Joshua lead the distribution
keyEvents.description: The priest Eleazar and Joshua son of Nun were appointed as chief leaders for the division of the land, with Elidad and the other tribal chiefs serving as assistants.
